Back to what you were doing

Musculoskeletal physiotherapy in Lindenpark. Forty minutes, one to one, every time.

Appointments are forty minutes and you see the same physiotherapist each time. Nobody is passed to an assistant halfway through, and nobody is put on a machine and left.

Most people need between three and six appointments. If you need more we will say so, and if you need fewer we will say that too.

40 minEvery appointment
3–6Appointments, typically
48hUsual wait for a first visit

1. First visit

    Assessment

    Forty minutes of questions and movement. You will leave with an explanation and something to do.

  2. After

    Treatment and exercises

    Hands-on work where it helps, and a programme that fits the week you actually have.

  3. Discharge

    You stop coming

    The aim from the first visit. We will tell you when, rather than waiting for you to drift away.

Book a first appointment

No referral needed. Most first appointments are available within two days.
